Package GUI

Class VisitorOrdersScreenController

java.lang.Object
GUI.VisitorOrdersScreenController
public class VisitorOrdersScreenController extends Object
Controller class for the visitor orders management screen. This class handles the display, interaction, and lifecycle of visitor orders, including editing, canceling, confirming, and reporting exits.
